Do you want to get your workout in while getting paid? We’ve got you! As a Logistics Employer at PostNL, you are the reason people get their packages on time. No boring office desk for you; you’ll be active, moving, and making things happen.

What we offer
- Flexible working hours
- Good salary: €14,99 per hour!
- Free afternoons: You're done by 13:00
- Weekly paid!
- Travel allowance starting from 6 kilometers
- Opportunities for growth

Who you are
You are a true go-getter who loves to stay active and keep moving. Hard work is part of your DNA, and lifting heavy packages is no problem for you—think of it as a free workout! To keep our operations running smoothly, you are available to join the team at least 4 days a week, including every Saturday. Here is everything else you need to know about working as a morning warehouse hero:

- Transportation: You have your own way to get to Ledeboerstraat 76 (bike, scooter, or car).
- Early Starts: You are ready to kick off your shift starting at 07:15 AM, finishing around 12:30 PM.
- Commitment: You are available to work on Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday (these are our mandatory busy days!).
- Communication: You speak either English or Dutch.
- Physical Strength: You are fit and capable of lifting packages up to 23 kg.

What will you do
As a Morning Warehouse Hero, you play a vital role in making sure every package hits the road as fast as possible! Your day will be packed with variety—from sorting and processing to loading and unloading trucks. You’ll make sure every incoming parcel is placed in the correct roll container before they head onto the conveyor belt for final sorting. Once everything is in its right place, it’s ready for delivery—great job, superstar! If you feel like you're ready for the next level after a while, there are plenty of growth opportunities to explore. Who knows, you might be our next Team Leader! Your working hours will be as follows:

- Workdays: Monday to Saturday
- Working hours: 07:15 until

Looking for a great job where teamwork and a friendly atmosphere come first? As a logistics worker at Mainfreight in Duiven, you will join a warm international team! You will earn a great salary of € 15,32 per hour (€ 2.655 per month), paid out weekly to your account. Add your travel allowance and the guarantee of free evenings in the day shift, and you have found your ideal workplace. Apply today and join our amazing team!

What we offer
- A great salary from € 2655 per month 💰
- A full-time position. 40 hours guaranteed!
- Fixed day shift from 08:00 to 17:00!
- Lots of international colleagues
- Travel allowance for your commute!
- Weekly payout of your salary!

Who you are
As a logistics worker, you bring positive energy to the warehouse floor. To smoothly join our team, you meet the following requirements:

- You speak and understand good English.
- You are available full-time or part-time for 32 to 40 hours per week.
- You are available to work from Monday to Friday.
- You have your own transportation to reach Mainfreight.
- You are able to get a proof of good conduct.

What will you do
As a logistics worker at Mainfreight, you and your friendly colleagues make sure all incoming and outgoing orders are processed with care. Together, you keep the warehouse organized and help each other out whenever needed. Whether you are sorting products or preparing orders, you never work alone.

Working fixed hours from 08:00 to 17:00 means you have a great work-life balance and plenty of time to relax in the evening!

Where will you work
Mainfreight in Duiven is a global logistics company with a very welcoming and open culture. As a logistics worker you will work in a close team where people greet each other with a smile and enjoy taking coffee breaks together. English is the main language on the floor, making it easy for everyone to connect. From day one, you will feel right at home!

Job application
Are you ready to enjoy your workday as a logistics worker at Mainfreigh

Can you picture yourself working in a massive clothing warehouse? At our client in Bleiswijk, you can! Get started as an order picker and earn an hourly wage of €14.99, which with allowances can increase up to €18.73 per hour. Want to start quickly? No problem! Apply directly and see your first paycheck in your bank account as soon as next week! 💸

- An hourly salary of €14,99 gross per hour
- Travel allowance: > 10 km
- Working in the latest clothing and fashion world!
- Chance of a permanent contract after 7 months!

Who you are
Are you the order picker we are looking for? Check it here:

- You are available 5 days per week on a flexible basis, in any case on Sundays and Mondays.
- You work in at least 2 shifts (night shifts are mandatory).
- You have a good command of the English language, both spoken and written.
- You can easily commute to our location in Bleiswijk.
- You have your own transport to travel to the location.
- You are willing to take off jewelry and piercings during work.

What will you do
Thousands of online orders flow in daily, and as an order picker, you ensure that every parcel is correct! 🛍️ With scanner in hand, you gather the trendiest fashion items across the huge warehouse: from the latest sneakers to stylish coats. Have you completed your picking list? Then you take the items to the packing department and immediately start the next round. Thanks to the active and varied work environment, your workday will fly by! 🚀

Work hours (3 shifts):

- 🌅 Morning shift: 06:00 – 14:30
- 🌆 Afternoon/evening shift: 14:30 – 23:30
- 🌙 Night shift: 22:00 – 06:00

Where will you work
You will be working at a leading logistics service provider in Bleiswijk that handles the complete logistics operation for a major online fashion retailer. As an order picker, you work daily with the newest clothing collections. You will do this in a dynamic and international team

As a packer 3 shifts, you will work full-time in a dynamic production environment where you are responsible for packing and inspecting plastic packaging. You work in a 3-shift system, which means you work at various times and receive an extra shift allowance. There are plenty of opportunities for growth, for example towards becoming an operator or forklift driver, and the company offers the prospect of permanent employment if you perform well.

You start your working day by operating a machine that produces plastic trays. At the end of the production line, you stack these trays, carefully check their quality, and pack them into cardboard boxes. You ensure the packaged products are neatly placed on a pallet. If you notice any irregularities, you report this immediately so the machine can be adjusted. During breaks, you coordinate with colleagues to ensure the work continues smoothly.

Do you want a stable job with security and room for growth? Then apply quickly as a packer 3 shifts and take your chance for a great future at a leading packaging manufacturer.

- 

- You are available full-time

- You have no problem working in a 3-shift system

- You can take responsibility for your own machine

- You are motivated to work for the long term

- Knowledge of the English language is a plus

In this role, you are the guardian of quality for highly specialized processes within an international high-tech company. The company develops, repairs, and inspects critical components for the aerospace, energy, and defense industries. Together with your team, you work every day to achieve the highest standards of quality and safety.

Your attention to detail and expertise in handling valuable and delicate components make you an essential partner for our customers. In addition, you participate in 5S projects aimed at making work processes safer and more efficient.

You will work in a rotating two-shift schedule: one week in the day shift (five days) and the next week in the evening shift (four days).

- Perform Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) inspections to ensure quality and detect discontinuities or defects using methods such as eddy current testing and ultrasonic testing
- Experience with: Visual inspections, dimensional inspections, receiving inspections and reading and interpreting technical drawings
- Knowledge of and experience with measuring instruments such as calipers and micrometers
- Good command of the English language
